findings.source_quote: Rejoice and praise the King of Kings!
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with “Furahini na msifu Mfalme wa Wafalme!”
findings.translation_quote: Furahi; mshangilie na mnumbeni Mfalme wa Wafalme!

findings.source_quote: Give thanks and laud, for more is here!
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with “Toeni shukrani na sifa, kwa maana mengi zaidi yamekuja!”
findings.translation_quote: Mpe shukrani na sifu, maana mema zaidi yamekuja hapa!

findings.source_quote: Extol and praise His worthy name!
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with “Litukuzeni na kulisifu jina lake linalostahili!”
findings.translation_quote: Mtukuzeni na mnumbeni jina lake linalostahili!

findings.suggested_fix: Replace with “Naye humimina baraka kutoka juu,”
findings.translation_quote: Na hunyesha baraka kama mvua kutoka mbinguni,

findings.source_quote: Adore and praise our mighty Lord!
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with “Mwabuduni na kumsifu Bwana wetu mkuu!”
findings.translation_quote: Mtukuzeni na mbariki Bwana wetu Mwenye Nguvu!

findings.source_quote: Give thanks and sing to Christ our King / And worship Him with reverent praise;
findings.suggested_fix: Replace these lines with “Toeni shukrani na kumwimbia Kristo, Mfalme wetu, / Nanyi mwabuduni kwa sifa za heshima;”
findings.translation_quote: Mshukuru na imbe kwa Kristo mfalme wetu / Na mnamwabudu kwa sifa za kuheshimu;

findings.source_quote: Adore th’ almighty King of Kings!
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with “Mwabuduni Mfalme wa Wafalme Mwenyezi!”
findings.translation_quote: Mtukuzeni Mfalme wa Wafalme Mwenye Nguvu!

gpt-4.1-mini.quality_note: Default cost-conscious candidate; not certified for theological accuracy in every language.

gpt-4.1-nano.quality_note: Lowest-cost option in this registry; benchmark before bulk publication.

gpt-5-mini.quality_note: Reasoning tokens consume output budget; benchmark total cost and quality.

gpt-6-astra.quality_note: Higher-cost manual recovery option. Documented API alias; no dated snapshot is published. Reasoning shares the output cap. Quality gates remain required.

gpt-6-luna.quality_note: Affordable default for new manual translation and review campaigns. Documented API alias; no dated snapshot is published. Reasoning shares the output cap. Benchmark theological accuracy; quality gates remain required.

gpt-6.1-sol.quality_note: Stronger downstream recovery option. Documented API alias; no dated snapshot is published. Reasoning shares the output cap. Quality gates remain required.
